title: Replace site logo with Terravedant logo

requirements.summary: Add optimized Terravedant logo static assets (128x128 and 512x512) under generated public assets.
acceptanceCriteria: Two new image files exist at frontend/public/assets/generated/terravedant-logo.dim_128x128.png and frontend/public/assets/generated/terravedant-logo.dim_512x512.png.
The generated images are visually based on IMG-20260210-WA0045-1.jpg and are crisp at their target sizes.

file_operations.description: Create an optimized 128x128 PNG logo derived from IMG-20260210-WA0045-1.jpg, ensuring crisp edges and square framing.
Create an optimized 512x512 PNG logo derived from IMG-20260210-WA0045-1.jpg, ensuring crisp edges and square framing.

requirements.summary: Point centralized brand logo paths to the new Terravedant generated assets.

file_operations.description: Update BRAND_ASSETS.logo.standard and BRAND_ASSETS.logo.large to reference '/assets/generated/terravedant-logo.dim_128x128.png' and '/assets/generated/terravedant-logo.dim_512x512.png' respectively.

requirements.summary: Ensure the header renders the new logo via BRAND_ASSETS.logo.standard with stable, non-distorted layout across breakpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: The header logo image displayed in frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx updates to the new Terravedant logo after the asset/path changes.
Logo remains properly contained (no stretching/cropping) across breakpoints (sm, md, lg) with existing Tailwind classes.

file_operations.description: Confirm the header continues to source from BRAND_ASSETS.logo.standard and remains object-contained across breakpoints; add non-breaking image attributes (e.g., explicit width/height or decoding/loading hints) only if needed to prevent layout shift while preserving existing Tailwind sizing.
